name: Amplifier Frequency Response, Feedback & Output Stages
summary: The second electronics course: differential pairs, amplifier bandwidth, negative feedback and stability, and power output stages.

topics.name: Differential pairs (BJT and MOS) and common-mode rejection
Low-frequency response: coupling and bypass capacitors
High-frequency transistor models and the Miller effect
Open-circuit time constants and bandwidth estimation
Negative feedback: topologies, loop gain and desensitivity
Stability, phase margin and frequency compensation
Internal architecture of an op-amp (two-stage design)
Output stages: class A, B and AB
